verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Fireworks exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs and is a drop-in replacement for OpenAI, implying developers can build against the well-known OpenAI SDKs by pointing them at Fireworks' endpoint. However, there is no evidence of Fireworks' own dedicated first-party SDKs (Python/Node client libraries) or SDK-specific quickstart guides, only API-compatibility claims. Missing for 10: explicit Fireworks-branded SDK documentation, language-specific SDK install/quickstart guides, and independent developer confirmation of SDK usage.
